name: task_compile_manager
description: Compile a natural-language task request into a runnable WORK OBJECT (the task runner's format). Use this when the user explicitly asks to compile/convert/create a task workflow or spec output, NOT when they want to execute a task immediately.

inputs.name: information
inputs.description: supporting context (names, dates, URLs, prior results) or ''

outputs.description: Structured tool result payload — compiled task spec / IR.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments to task_compile_manager are:
- task: required task text to compile.
- information: optional supporting context and constraints.

metadata.planner_description: Compiles a request into a task-workflow spec (task_ir). Use ONLY when asked to compile/convert a workflow — not to execute one.
